scope: Phase 7 delivers tactical combat depth through config-first combat contracts, explicit bot tactical intent, cover-aware positioning, role-aware weapon selection, tactical HUD/debug visibility, and a deterministic verification loop for tuning.
constraints: Execution baseline remains work/2D-FPS-game and must preserve the completed Phase 6 weather and environment stack.
Reusable tactical decisions stay in domain modules and Phaser-specific wiring stays in scenes and presentation.
Combat tuning values remain authored in assets/data/game-balance.json rather than hardcoded in runtime logic.
Existing public debug methods remain stable; only payloads may be extended.
MainScene.ts must stay within the 850 line gate.
Bot decisions must remain deterministic under controlled time, HP, weather, LOS, and distance inputs.
Weather and wind remain supported tactical inputs, not parallel feature work.
New assets, vehicles, and pathfinding are out of scope for this phase.

implemented: botTactics, weaponRoles, and combatTuning contracts are active in balance data and scene-facing types.
Bots now expose pressure, hold, retreat, and flank intent with deterministic state transitions.
Cover-aware positioning and line-of-sight checks drive retreat and flank target choice.
Weapon selection now considers role profiles rather than only distance.
HUD and debug snapshots now expose tactical intent, target cover data, and chosen weapon role.
Targeted tactical unit and E2E verification is in place for the Phase 7 behavior set.
gaps: Full-suite browser regression coverage was not rerun in this closeout; tactical coverage was rerun instead.

acceptance: Phase 7 planning, specialist handoff, implementation, and verification artifacts are present.
Config-first tactical combat contracts are active without breaking prior phase behavior.
AI tactical states, positioning, weapon-role selection, and HUD/debug tactical visibility are implemented.
Targeted tactical unit and E2E verification passed.
Execution report and postflight sync were refreshed for the completed phase.
priority: 2. Implement tactical AI, positioning, and weapon roles in parallel.
3. Expose tactical state to HUD and debug consumers.
4. Close with deterministic tests, tuning docs, execution report, and postflight sync.

risks.risk: AI state churn could regress into oscillation if thresholds are retuned carelessly.
risks.mitigation: Keep transition logic covered by deterministic tests and preserve cooldown-based stabilization.

risks.risk: Snapshot shape drift could break HUD or debug consumers.
risks.mitigation: Treat tactical payload fields as optional contract fields and update both sides together.
